shared_widgets.name: SsAppBar
shared_widgets.description: Top app bar with ShirtStack title or screen title, optional back affordance (48dp), and cart icon button with optional badge count. Uses primary/onPrimary tokens; semantic labels on all actions.

shared_widgets.name: ProductCard
shared_widgets.description: Catalog card showing primary image (semantic label = product title), title (titleMedium), formatted USD price from integer cents (priceMedium), and attribute chips for available sizes, color, and fit type. Minimum tap target 48dp; used in ProductListScreen grid/list.

shared_widgets.name: FilterChipBar
shared_widgets.description: Horizontal scrollable filter chips for size, color, price range, and shirt type. Selected state uses primary fill; unselected uses surfaceVariant. Each chip ≥48dp height; announces selection state to screen readers.

shared_widgets.name: SearchField
shared_widgets.description: Real-time client-side search TextField filtering by product title and attributes. Clear button (≥48dp); hint and semantics label 'Search shirts'.

shared_widgets.name: VariantSelector
shared_widgets.description: Single-select size and color chip groups on product detail. Selected variant highlighted with primary outline/fill; disabled unavailable options use disabled token. Each option ≥48dp touch target.

shared_widgets.name: StickyAddToCartBar
shared_widgets.description: Pinned bottom bar on ProductDetailScreen with quantity stepper and Add to cart primary button. Bar and button height ≥48dp; remains visible while scrolling. Shows brief SnackBar confirmation on success.

shared_widgets.name: PriceText
shared_widgets.description: Formats integer cents + ISO 4217 USD as display string (e.g. $27.99). Uses price color token; never floating-point math. Semantics: 'Price {formatted}'.

shared_widgets.name: EmptyState
shared_widgets.description: Centered illustration placeholder, title, and body for empty catalog or no filter/search matches. Optional clear-filters action button ≥48dp.

shared_widgets.name: ErrorState
shared_widgets.description: Error icon, message, and Retry button (≥48dp) for catalog load failures. Uses error/onError tokens.

shared_widgets.name: LoadingSkeleton
shared_widgets.description: Shimmer placeholders matching ProductCard or detail layout while AsyncNotifier is loading. Announce 'Loading' via semantics live region.

shared_widgets.name: CartLineItem
shared_widgets.description: Cart row with product name, unit price (cents copied at add), size/color, quantity stepper (−/+, ≥48dp), and remove control. Decrement to zero or remove deletes the line and recalculates subtotal.

shared_widgets.name: ReturnsPolicySection
shared_widgets.description: Expandable or static section on product detail: 30-day returns on unworn items with original tags; refunds to original payment method; exchanges as return plus new order; contact email to initiate return.

shared_widgets.name: SsPrimaryButton
shared_widgets.description: Filled primary CTA, min height 48dp, min width 48dp, labelLarge on onPrimary. Disabled state uses disabled token; always has semantic label.

shared_widgets.name: SsIconButton
shared_widgets.description: Icon-only control with 48dp minimum tap target and required semanticLabel (e.g. Open cart, Go back, Decrease quantity).

screens.name: ProductListScreen
screens.purpose: Browse the locally seeded men's shirts catalog (~20–40 SKUs) with title, formatted USD price, primary image, sizes, color, and fit type; support client-side filters (size, color, price range, shirt type) and real-time search; entry point for M1 demo.

screens.name: ProductDetailScreen
screens.purpose: Show shirt title, description, formatted USD price, primary image, size/color selectors, fit type, and 30-day returns policy; sticky add-to-cart bar (≥48dp) adds selected variant quantity 1 to in-memory cart with SnackBar confirmation.

screens.name: CartScreen
screens.purpose: Display in-memory cart line items with product name, unit price (cents at add), size/color, quantity controls, and running USD subtotal; remove or decrement to zero removes line; cart clears on app restart in M1.

navigation.trigger: Tap ProductCard for a shirt SKU
Tap cart icon in SsAppBar or after add-to-cart confirmation action
Tap back or Continue shopping when cart empty
Tap a cart line item to reopen that product detail

accessibility: Minimum touch target 48×48 dp for all interactive controls (chips, buttons, icon buttons, quantity steppers, ProductCard).
Text and icon contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA against light and dark theme backgrounds (onSurface on background/surface; onPrimary on primary; onSecondary on secondary; price on surface).
All images and icons expose semantic labels (product title for primary images; action verbs for icons).
Support system font scaling (textScaleFactor) without clipping on ProductListScreen and ProductDetailScreen; wrap long titles with maxLines and ellipsis where needed.
Announce loading via semantics live region; EmptyState and ErrorState expose clear headings and actionable Retry/Clear filters labels.
VariantSelector announces selected size and color to screen readers; StickyAddToCartBar button label includes selected variant when present (e.g. Add Medium Blue to cart).
Focus order follows visual reading order: search/filters → list → app bar actions; detail: image → info → variants → returns → sticky CTA.
Do not rely on color alone for selected filter/variant state; use outline weight or checkmark plus color.
Cart badge count is also available via Semantics on the cart icon (e.g. Cart, 3 items).
Respect reduced-motion preferences: disable shimmer animation when system reduce-motion is on; keep static skeleton.
